name: hcapp_updateDownDown
description: Updates the charge text, song choice/ID, and optionally the charge photo URL on an existing DownDown. Only the original creator or a GM/RA for the kennel may edit. chargePhotoUrl is merged with COALESCE — pass NULL to leave the existing photo unchanged (there is no way to clear it via this SP). Scoped to eventId + kennelId for safety. New feature — no HC5 equivalent.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device UUID. Passed to HC6.ValidateAppAuth for auth resolution.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived auth token validated against DeviceSecret.

parameters.name: kennelId
parameters.description: Kennel that owns the event. Used as auth scope and as part of the UPDATE WHERE clause. Required — null or zero-UUID triggers validation error.

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: Event the DownDown belongs to. Used as part of the UPDATE WHERE clause. Required — null or zero-UUID triggers validation error.

parameters.name: downDownId
parameters.description: DownDown to update. Required — null or zero-UUID triggers validation error. If no DownDown matches downDownId + eventId + kennelId, returns errorCode 4041, errorType 3.

parameters.name: chargeText
parameters.description: New charge text. Required — empty or whitespace-only triggers validation error.

parameters.name: songChoice
parameters.description: Updated suggested song name (free text). Stored as NULL if blank or not supplied.

parameters.name: songId
parameters.description: Updated FK to HC.Song. NULL to clear the song association.

parameters.name: chargePhotoUrl
parameters.description: Updated charge photo blob URL. Uses COALESCE(@chargePhotoUrl, ChargePhotoUrl) — passing NULL leaves the existing value unchanged. There is no way to clear the photo via this SP.

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: Compact error envelope returned on auth, validation, not-found, or unhandled errors: { success=0, errorCode, errorType }. Mutually exclusive with SuccessEnvelope rowset.

rowsets.name: SuccessEnvelope
rowsets.description: Returned on successful update: { success=1, errorCode=NULL, errorType=NULL }. Mutually exclusive with ErrorEnvelope rowset.
Returned (at index 1) alongside the ErrorEnvelope (index 0) on any auth, validation, not-found, or unhandled error.

sideEffects: Updates HC.DownDowns: sets ChargeText, SongChoice, SongId, ChargePhotoUrl (via COALESCE), UpdatedAt where id + eventId + kennelId match.
Writes to HC.ErrorLog on auth, validation, not-found, or unhandled errors.

codeSmells.issue: No way to clear ChargePhotoUrl via this SP
codeSmells.detail: ChargePhotoUrl is updated with COALESCE(@chargePhotoUrl, ChargePhotoUrl). If the caller wants to remove a charge photo, there is no way to do it through this SP — passing NULL leaves the existing URL. A sentinel empty-string or a separate @clearPhoto flag would be needed to support photo removal.

codeSmells.issue: No TRY/CATCH wrapping the UPDATE statement
codeSmells.detail: The main UPDATE is not inside a BEGIN TRY block. An unexpected DB error will propagate as a raw SQL error. XACT_ABORT ON ensures rollback, but the caller receives an unstructured error.
